title: Backup: Playmaker's First Deck (lore build)
summary: The Backup cards are Playmaker's "cybernetic employees" in VRAINS, and they only make sense inside his Cyberse deck. So this list is that deck as he plays it in season 1, against the Knights of Hanoi.

summary.title: Who's in it, and why
points: Backup Secretary, Backup Operator and Backup Supervisor, plus Backup @Ignister (2025), the newest card named Backup. It belongs to Ai's @Ignister line.
His season 1 Cyberse: Cyberse Wizard, Dotscaper, Stack Reviver, ROM Cloudia, Draconnet with Bitron, Linkslayer, Balancer Lord, Backlinker and Cyberse Gadget.
His Spells and Traps: Cynet Universe, Cynet Backdoor, Cynet Mining and Cyberse Beacon.
Extra Deck: Decode Talker, Encode Talker, Link Spider, Honeybot, Security Dragon, Talkback Lancer, Link Disciple and Link Devotee, ending in Firewall Dragon.

summary.title: How it plays
points: Backup Secretary summons itself next to any Cyberse, and Backup Operator swaps itself in for a linked monster.
Backup @Ignister summons itself next to a Cyberse from the Extra Deck and searches a DARK Cyberse.
Link Summoned with Secretary, Backup Supervisor brings in more Cyberse after battles, and calls Secretary back when it falls.
Draconnet calls Bitron from the Deck, Stack Reviver and Dotscaper come back after being material, and Cyberse Beacon searches when you take damage.

main: Backup Secretary
Summons itself while you control a Cyberse.
Backup Operator
Swaps itself in for a monster a Link points to.
Backup @Ignister
Newest: summons itself next to an Extra Deck Cyberse; searches a DARK Cyberse.
ROM Cloudia
Recovers a Cyberse; calls one from the Deck when destroyed.
Dotscaper
Returns when sent to the GY or banished.
Bitron
Level 2 Normal that Draconnet and Link Spider call.
Cyberse Wizard
Playmaker's opening Cyberse: forces a monster to Defense and pierces.
Stack Reviver
Revives a fellow Link material once per Duel.
Draconnet
Calls a Level 2 or lower Normal from the Deck.
Linkslayer
Summons itself onto an empty field; discards to destroy Spells/Traps.
Balancer Lord
Pays LP for an extra Cyberse Normal Summon.
Backlinker
Summons itself against their Extra Monster Zone; clears both.
Cyberse Gadget
Revives a Level 2 or lower; leaves a Gadget Token.
Cynet Mining
Discards to search a Level 4 or lower Cyberse.
Cynet Universe
Field Spell: pumps Links; shuffles a monster from a GY back.
Cynet Backdoor
Banishes a Cyberse to search a weaker one; it returns to attack directly.
Cyberse Beacon
Searches a small Cyberse after you take damage.
extra: Link-2 from Secretary: calls a Cyberse after battle; revives Secretary when it falls.
Playmaker's first ace Link-3: grows per linked monster; negates targeting.
Link-3: protects a linked monster in battle and passes on ATK.
Link-1: summons a small Normal Monster where it points.
Link-2: shields the monsters it points to.
Link-2: bounces a monster while co-linked.
Link-1: tributes a linked monster to draw.
Link-1: leaves two Link Tokens when tributed while co-linked.
Link-4: the ace Playmaker gains at the end of season 1.
